dashboard.title: Help & Support
dashboard.description: Get help, find answers, and contact our support team.
dashboard.ticketDescription: Tell us about the issue you're facing.
dashboard.contactDescription: Reach out to us via email, phone, or live chat.
dashboard.quickContactDescription: Send us a quick message and we'll get back to you.

support.liveChatDescription: Chat with our support team in real time.
support.emailSupportDescription: Send us an email and we'll respond soon.

resetPassword.question: How do I reset my password?
resetPassword.answer: Go to settings and choose 'Change Password'.

updateProfile.question: How can I update my profile?
updateProfile.answer: Navigate to your profile page and edit your information.

deleteAccount.question: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: Contact support to request account deletion.

dataSecurity.question: How is my data secured?
dataSecurity.answer: We use encryption and strict access controls to protect your data.

sharingSettings.question: Can I control sharing settings?
sharingSettings.answer: Yes, adjust sharing preferences in settings.

moodTracking.question: How does mood tracking work?
moodTracking.answer: Record your mood in journal reflections and view insights over time.

journalReflections.question: Where can I find my journal reflections?
journalReflections.answer: Go to the Journal tab to see and manage reflections.
